claims.text: The authors propose SwarmX, a scheduler designed around multi-call and tool-using agent workloads rather than independent inference requests.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.finding: SwarmX targets agentic workloads composed of model calls and tool executions; the paper reports production-scale cluster context and evaluation of scheduling for GPU/CPU resources.
